articles.title: China says to impose extra 55% tariffs on some beef imports
articles.mainIdea: China says to impose extra 55% tariffs on some beef imports
articles.summary: AFP: China says to impose extra 55% tariffs on some beef imports. China said on Wednesday it will impose additional 55 percent tariffs on some beef imports from countries including Brazil, Australia and the United States that exceed a certain quantity from January 1.Countries have been assigned annual quotas and beef sent to China will be subject to the extra 55 percent levy if imports go beyond that amount.
